karpathyAgentGuidelines.name: Karpathy-inspired Agent Guidelines
karpathyAgentGuidelines.description: Karpathy-inspired guardrails that curb common LLM coding mistakes — think before coding, keep it simple, make surgical changes, and verify against goals. Merge with your project-specific instructions.

header.title: Agent pages
header.description: Agent pages store instructions, skills, and memory for Ask and MCP clients. MCP clients must read an Agent page or build a bundle; pages are not injected into prompts automatically.

categories.sensitiveHint: Sensitive category: only workspace owners can activate a draft here.

injectionPolicyHint.always: Always: included in AI bundles whenever the page is readable.
injectionPolicyHint.default_on: Default on: included automatically unless the page is disabled.
injectionPolicyHint.task_matched: Task matched: included only when it matches the AI's current task.
injectionPolicyHint.permission_scoped: Permission scoped: included whenever the requester's permissions match.
